actions.initialQuestion: Show source target result only and four source-selected jump choices.
actions.first: Only first source jump can start the equation; correct placement locks it at source destination and shows partial equation.
actions.second: Correct second jump requires first already placed; show full source equation, disable all jumps and New, play157from2; at25 reset157to1 and enableNew only.
actions.wrong: Wrong order or distractor on number line resets that jump, disables jumps and New, shows exact source wrong feedback and starts random coach46.
actions.outside: Outside target resets the jump and starts coach46 without a popup or disabling choices.
actions.close: Source150 release hides containing wrong153 and enables New/all jumps; first placed jump remains locked by source x guard. Coach46 is not stopped.
actions.newProblem: When enabled, hide/reset four choices from exact source pool and enable choices; existing Coach46 continues. No source score or page-completion callback.
actions.replay: Reset entire intro, question/coach seed, four choices, tracks, popup and pointer state.
